notes.title: Mobile Update
notes.notes:
Hello Humans

Our latest blending experiment is complete!
Combine Steam humans with Android humans and iOS humans to create the ultimate crossplay lobby!

Go online on the go and play your favourite DNA Auto Battler on Steam Deck, Android and iOS Devices.

On sale now!
